t: A Turkmen tribal dynasty that reunited Iran in the 1790s and ruled from Tehran, which it made the capital.
Wars with Russia cost Iran the Caucasus by 1828, and Britain and Russia competed for influence over the weak state.
The Constitutional Revolution of 1906 created a parliament; Reza Khan’s coup of 1921 led to the dynasty’s fall in 1925.
dyk: Naser al-Din Shah was an enthusiastic photographer who took and developed pictures himself, and thousands of Qajar-era photographs survive in the Golestan Palace collections.
ev: Agha Mohammad Khan makes Tehran his capital
Agha Mohammad Khan is crowned shah
Treaty of Gulistan cedes Georgia and most of the Caucasian khanates to Russia
Treaty of Turkmenchay surrenders Erivan and Nakhichevan
Amir Kabir founds the Dar ol-Fonun in Tehran
The Tobacco Protest forces cancellation of a British monopoly
The Majlis deposes Ahmad Shah, ending the dynasty
